description: Change one task in the connected LoopGantt ACCOUNT (requires signing in to LoopGantt, or an API key). Pass the taskId from list_tasks and only the fields to change. To mark a task done use complete_task — LoopGantt couples status and progress, and complete_task says exactly that. Set agentLabel to claim a task for a bot (null releases it); assigneeId is for a real person.

agentLabel.description: The bot (agent) that owns this task, e.g. "qa-bot" (1-64 characters) - so a team of agents can split one board. Use your own stable name. assigneeId is for a real PERSON; leave it alone unless a human should own the task.

assigneeId.description: Assign to this user id (the project owner or an accepted member), or null to unassign

deadline.description: Finish-by date YYYY-MM-DD (a marker, not a constraint)

durationDays.description: Working days; 0 makes it a milestone

status.description: Workflow stage id - use one of the project's stage ids (list_projects shows each project's stages; any other value is stored as sent, shown in the board's first column, and warned about), e.g. not_started, in_progress, on_hold, completed, or todo, in_progress, blocked, waiting_approval, done on an agent board. Prefer complete_task for 'done'.

name: update_task
